subject: general
question: In February 2022, which of the following persons was nominated for Laureus 'World Breakthrough of the Year' award?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Neeraj Chopra.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Neeraj Chopra was nominated for the prestigious** 'Laureus World Breakthrough of the Year** award 2022 for his historic gold medal win at the Tokyo 2020 Olympics.
 
• Neeraj Chopra is an **Indian track and field athlete **who is the reigning Olympic champion and world championship silver medalist in the javelin throw.
 
• He is the first Asian athlete to win an **Olympic gold medal in the men's javelin throw.**
 
• Neeraj Chopra fought the odds and Johannes Vetter won** the men's javelin throw gold medal** at the Tokyo Olympics.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e5bb88d1efb121b237d54f7d9cad14964cabe080fa30d1866d5d472af0681595.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Maxence "Max" Parrot** is a Canadian snowboarder.​ 
 
• He is the reigning Olympic champion in slopestyle, winning gold at the 2022 Winter Olympics and also winning a silver in the event at the** 2018 Winter Olympics. **
 
• **Sachin Ramesh Tendulkar** is an Indian former international cricketer who captained the Indian national team.
 
• **Vinesh Phogat is an Indian wrestler**. She became the first Indian woman wrestler to win gold in both Commonwealth and Asian Games.
